roof_ridge.description: Saddle ridge cap with an open underside, shaped crown and doubled weather lap.

oak_joined_post.description: Adzed structural oak post with shouldered head, projecting tenon and uneven hewing along the full grain direction.

curved_brace.description: Crook-grown knee brace fitted between the post shoulder and wall plate; concave lower sweep retains the natural grain path.

ledged_plank.description: Rebated door, shutter and loft-floor plank with chamfered heads, full board thickness and modeled edge irregularity.

forged_hinge.description: Forged butterfly strap hinge with swelled leaf, folded root and a hammered scalloped end.

square_nail.description: Individually forged square nail head with a skewed pyramidal crown and nonuniform hammered edges.

threshold.description: Worn threshold or coping slab with a rounded nosing and sloped rain-shedding top face.

plaster_infill.description: Lime-plaster infill panel fitted within timber framing, slightly concave and uneven at its hand-trowelled perimeter.

arch_spandrel.description: Continuous authored barrel arch and spandrel. The opening is topology, not a painted door or primitive boolean; its jambs and soffit have full masonry thickness.

arch_voussoir.description: Tapered wedge voussoir with dressed radial beds, cleft visible face and a proud softened outer arris.

splayed_arrow_slit.description: Actual pierced arrow slit with a widened internal splay and a continuous dressed lintel.

sunburst_relief.description: Original asymmetric rising-sun relief used as the Sunmeadow civic mark; hand-cut rays and a raised face.

cloth_pennant.description: Thick woven green civic pennant with a folded top and three tailored hanging points; original Sunmeadow colors.

gate_leaf_plank.description: Fortified gate stave with full 220mm thickness, shouldered head, weathered lower toe and subtle hand-hewn bow.

forged_pintle.description: Forged hinge pintle with an upset head, chamfered bearing shoulder and irregular square driving end.
